category_title: Students who engage in physical aggression when unable to ignore peer provocation
scenario_title: Peer provocation during independent table work
minimal_context: The student is sitting at a table with peers working on a classwork assignment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please continue working on your assignment at your table.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm trying to do my work, but they kept saying rude comments to me. I just sometimes ignore them.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to ignore them and focus on your paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: They kept talking about me. When I can't ignore it no more, I just go off.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just keep working quietly at our seats.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I didn't want to fight her, but she got in my face and she pushed me from my seat! She said 'Let's throw hands', so I just snapped on her!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please continue working on your assignment at your table.

STUDENT: I'm trying to do my work, but they kept saying rude comments to me. I just sometimes ignore them.
